mission: Root cause of the #140 staging verification timeouts (owner request 2026-10-16): when a browser check's networkidle wait times out, the verifier's masked failure names the requests still loading (resource type plus path on the staging site, host elsewhere, never a query string). Staging only; no deployment, data write, secret, setting, workflow or collector change.

impacts.reason: browser_check tracks open requests (request/requestfinished/requestfailed) and, only when page.goto raises, adds still_loading() to the stage label before re-raising. request_label() keeps the path for the staging origin and the host elsewhere; queries are dropped. Checks, order, timeouts and pass/fail conditions are unchanged. Not in either collector's import graph.
still_loading names paths and hosts, drops queries and tokens, caps the list and reports nothing when idle.
